title: I would go back without thinking twice
text:
It was a wonderful experience with my wife, coincidentally I met a guide who was also Brazilian named Nicolas Costa, super efficient and fun, which made the experience even better.

I am a very reserved person without the habit of attending places like this, it was a rare thing for me to do but definitely a very good experience
